## Finding

The /auth/login and /auth/token endpoints have no rate limiting enforcement.

## Impact

Attackers can brute force credentials or perform token harvesting.

## Evidence

- 1000 requests in 10s window, all 200 OK.
- No rate-limit headers returned.

## Remediation

Implement rate limiting at the API gateway; default to 10 req/min per IP.
